title: Verdict
x-source-of-truth: gate internal/verify/verify.go (type Verdict) — the PROMOTED type; the reducer there is the behavioral source of truth. The workbench-redesign POC copy is ancestral and stale (string producer).
x-versioning-note: First versioned expression of the contract (pays the redesign RED-TEAM #7 unimportable/unversioned debt). Per the gate steward: this schema must be conformance-tested against gate's verify.Verdict and should graduate to live next to that type in gate — never maintained as an independent copy. v0.2.0: producer is a structured {class, impl} object. v0.3.0 (ci-classify design, gate PR #10): Finding gains an optional `evidence` field — the verbatim log line / diff span a finding quotes, the substrate the extract-shaped verifiers check; omitempty so existing rungs are unaffected. v0.4.0 (decision provenance): an optional `decider` object — who authored a JUDGMENT, through which channel, and when by their own clock. Additive and omitempty, so verdicts written before it still validate; the write path, not the reader, is where an unattributed new judgment is refused.
description: The one artifact body every verifier emits — code, local-model, or judgment. Two orthogonal axes: `decision` (block > escalate > pass) is INDEPENDENT of `tier` (risk band). Composition is monotone (Reduce): worst decision wins, max tier wins, min confidence carries. Ladder law: a local-model producer may only pass or escalate — a `block` from it is a structural violation (ErrLocalBlock), which is what makes 'a local classifier never gates a merge' free.

subject.description: What the verdict is about. PR-shaped today; a CI verdict is really about a run but reuses the PR subject.

source.description: The verifier that produced this verdict, e.g. 'triage-floor', 'review-consolidation', 'ci-classify'.

producer.description: Who stands behind the verdict. Class carries the ladder semantics (the only values the reducer accepts); impl names the specific implementation for provenance only — nothing may branch on it.

tier.description: Risk band; unknown values rank highest (fail closed).

decider.description: Who stands behind a JUDGMENT-class verdict and how that identity was established. Absent on code and local-model verdicts (a deterministic verifier has no decider) and on judgments predating the field. Provenance only — the reducer must never branch on it.

who.description: The deciding identity: an operator's name, or the provider/model projection for a delegated auto-judgment.

method.description: The channel the decision arrived through — cli-operator, slack-interactive, or auto-<provider>. It names the channel, never an authenticated claim: gate authenticates none of them.

at.description: When the decision was made, RFC 3339 UTC — the decider's clock, distinct from the artifact envelope's append time.
